# `aitbc crosschain rates`

Get configured cross-chain swap rates between chains.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc crosschain rates [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--from-chain` | text | — | no | Source chain ID |
| `--to-chain` | text | — | no | Target chain ID |
| `--from-token` | text | — | no | Source token symbol |
| `--to-token` | text | — | no | Target token symbol |
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC URL |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc crosschain rates
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc crosschain rates --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
